messages.author: ead554d6657c915b
messages.subject: Controlling Width of Tree Plot
parts:
Is there a way to control the absolute width of the plotted tree?
For example, if the tree defaults to a width of 4 cm, but I would like to make the width 2 cm.
Is "xlim(NA,##)" the best option?

messages.author: f0dc0fdb872722c6
messages.subject: Re: Controlling Width of Tree Plot
parts:
xlim is use to set the x-axis limits.

There is actually no 'absolute width' for a tree plotted in plotting device (quartz, X11, window).

You can set absolute width by saving the plot to file (pdf, png, etc) by specifying the width parameter.
